name: researchzy
description: Find and use the literature with real papers: search about 250 million records, manage your library and PDFs, write literature reviews that cite only what the search returned, develop research ideas with a logged novelty check, find papers for uncited sentences and keep the quote that supports each, and choose where to submit from evidence. Needs a Researchzy account.

interface.shortDescription: Search papers, review the literature, find citations and choose a journal.
interface.longDescription: Search by DOI, arXiv, title or keywords; manage your library, download PDFs and add your PDFs to library papers; write a literature review with logged searches, screening and a synthesis that cites only papers the index returned; develop research ideas whose novelty is checked against real papers; find papers for the sentences of a draft that need a citation, read them and keep the quote that supports each; and shortlist journals from where similar papers and your references were published. Needs a Researchzy account.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find papers in Researchzy and show their metadata and PDF availability.
